scoring_rule: Scores represent recorded evidence, not confidence. Overall 10 is a gate, not an average.
external_evidence_required: observed disaster recovery drill where appropriate

categories.requirement: One authoritative Staff release configuration plus direct-route enforcement, with authorization remaining separately authoritative.
evidence: Dedicated employee app and role redirect exist
Current employee home/route audit completed
automated_proof: Existing employee-app contract tests prove management route blocking
manual_proof: Current Home links visibly expose Training, Time Clock and Tips, which conflicts with the newly locked Staff release scope
known_gaps: Unreleased employee-prefixed routes are not release-gated
categories.reason_score_cannot_be_higher: The central invariant requested for the next Staff release is not implemented yet.

categories.requirement: Explicit domain/dependency/trust boundaries, ADRs, versioned contracts, environment strategy and enforceable architecture rules.
evidence: Repository/domain inventory inspected
Existing architecture/toolchain documentation exists
System/trust boundary baseline diagrams recorded in Phase 0
manual_proof: Current route, library, CI, Supabase and deployment surfaces inspected

overall.reason: Overall 10/10 is a gate, not an average. Multiple required gates and external/elapsed-time evidence are intentionally unsatisfied.
